about: The sculpted pieces: node tools/models.mjs site/models tools/figures.json --from <work dir> --held <work dir>/held --index src/map/shelf.js. Each file is first cut in Blender by tools/blend.py with the options in blend (sources in 3d-sources/2026-11-27, read as data). Sizes in cell radii, as the recipes they stand in for.
